data.text: hook prompt says nothing when the payload reaches stdin late: (sleep 1; echo '{"prompt":"Can we switch the core to async file reads?"}') | kadence hook prompt prints nothing and exits 0, while the same echo without the sleep prints DEC-39. Also seen with a python3 writer (BrokenPipe on its side). Claude Code writes the payload at once, so the hook works there; a slower writer — a wrapper script, another agent's hook runner — gets silence that looks like 'nothing relevant'. Not fixed in KAD-78.
